title: 10-K annual report filing
content: Meta Platforms filed its annual 10-K report with the SEC. Key disclosures include AI infrastructure investment plans, regulatory risk factors related to EU Digital Markets Act compliance, and updated segment reporting for Family of Apps and Reality Labs.

title: 8-K earnings release
content: Meta Platforms issued an 8-K with Q4 2025 earnings results. Revenue $48.4B, EPS $8.02 (GAAP), daily active people 3.35 billion across family of apps.
